I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in the channel on Oct 14, and nothing posted there since has changed it.

One thing to flag: my wrap-up note from the last request also ended up in #central-team as its own message (Oct 14, ts …125), not only in this chat. It contains nothing sensitive, but the Central team can see it.
